rooms.name: Castle grounds
rooms.short: Outside the castle. A small tree stands left of centre, a tower rises on the right, and a door is set low on the left.
rooms.long: The ground in front of the castle. On the far left, a door is set in the wall. A second door sits just to its right, closer to the middle. A small tree stands left of centre, with a gap behind it. A tall tower rises at the far right.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: The game gave no look line for the room, the tree, either door, or the rope. Layout comes from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen is 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially the tree gap.

100.label: small tree, leads behind it
100.note: Engine name is ARBOLITO (Spanish, small tree). Look gives no line. Please confirm the tree really is the way through.

101.label: castle door
101.note: Left of centre, x 82 to 100. Look gave no line.

141.name: rope
141.description: A rope on the ground at the far right, below the tower.
141.note: Hotspot is not visible in the dump (visible 0) and the hero already held the rope. Look gave only filler. Description is a guess from the name and position; reviewer to confirm or drop.

173.name: far left door
173.description: A door set in the castle wall at the far left.
173.note: Not an engine exit (door 0). Look line: I CAN'T SEE ANYTHING IN PARTICULAR. The coverage report calls it a fake door. Kept as object, not exit.

179.name: tower
179.description: A tall tower at the far right of the castle.
179.note: Look line: IT'S NOT UNUSUAL. Nothing more was said, so nothing more is claimed.

rooms.name: Behind the tree
rooms.short: A small space behind the tree. A branch runs across the middle, and the way out is along the bottom of the screen.
rooms.long: The space behind the small tree outside the castle. A branch spans the middle of the scene, left of centre. A magpie perches near it, and a small key lies to the right. The way back to the castle grounds runs along the whole bottom edge.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). The magpie and key were not visible (visible 0) when surveyed, so they may appear only in some states. Reviewer: check against a screenshot.

102.label: back to the castle grounds
102.note: Engine name SALIDA (Spanish, exit). Hotspot is a thin strip along the whole bottom edge, so the player leaves by walking off the bottom. Look gave no line.

52.name: magpie
52.description: A magpie perched left of centre. The game says it looks evil-minded.
52.note: Hidden (visible 0) in the survey dump. Look line: IT LOOKS LIKE THIS MAGPIE IS EVIL-MINDED. Typed npc as it is a creature the player deals with; reviewer may prefer object.

140.name: branch
140.description: A branch across the middle of the scene, left of centre.
140.note: Look line is only filler (THERE IS NOTHING SPECIAL ABOUT IT), so nothing more is claimed.

180.name: key
180.description: A small key on the right side, above the middle.
180.note: Hidden (visible 0) in the survey dump. The game gave no look line, only filler. Description is from name and position only.

rooms.name: Entrance hall
rooms.short: The castle hall. A door on the right leads outside and a door on the far left leads further in. Two speakers stand in the middle.
rooms.long: The hall just inside the castle. A door on the far left leads further in. A speaker stands left of centre and another right of centre. A picture hangs on the back wall at the right, with a small table below it. A door at the far right leads back outside.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot, especially what the speakers are.

103.label: door on the far right, back outside
103.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json.

104.label: door on the far left, to the corridor
104.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json. Room 24 has no name from the game, so 'corridor' is my wording; reviewer to confirm.

142.name: draskis
142.description: Something the game calls draskis, on the right near the table.
142.note: Hidden (visible 0) when surveyed. Look line is only filler. Coverage report says DRASKIS is covered or harmless, so I kept the name and made no change. Reviewer: confirm the spelling and whether to drop the textFixSuggestion.

170.name: speaker
170.description: A speaker on a stand. There are two: one left of centre and one right of centre.
170.note: Two hotspots share number 170 (rects at x 87 and x 186). Look lines are only filler, so nothing is claimed about what they do.

171.name: table
171.description: A small table at the right, below the picture.

174.name: picture
174.description: A picture on the back wall at the right.
174.note: Look line is only filler, so the subject is unknown. Reviewer: check a screenshot.

rooms.name: Tapestry corridor
rooms.short: A corridor with a wide staircase in the middle. Doors are on the far left and on the right, and a tapestry hangs by each.
rooms.long: A corridor inside the castle. A wide staircase rises in the middle. A door on the far left has a tapestry hanging beside it. A second tapestry hangs on the right, next to a door that leads back to the entrance hall.
rooms.provenance: drafted by Kiro from game text only
rooms.note: No room look line. Name and layout from hotspot rectangles in state.json (screen 320 wide). Reviewer: check against a screenshot.

105.label: door on the right, back to the entrance hall
105.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json.

106.label: door on the far left, to Igor's room
106.note: Look gave only filler. Destination from meta.json. 'Igor's room' comes from the coverage report, not from the game; reviewer to confirm a blind player should hear it before meeting him.

108.label: staircase in the middle, going up
108.note: Engine name ESCALERAS (Spanish, stairs). Look was silent.

151.name: tapestry
151.description: A tapestry hanging on the wall. There are two: one at the left and one at the right. The game says she has nice Transylvanian features.
151.note: Two hotspots share number 151 (x 23 and x 226). The look line speaks of 'she', so the tapestries probably show a woman; reviewer to check a screenshot. The coverage report says TAPESTRIE already has a pack fix.
